🎬 The Sand (2015)

The Sand follows a group of college students who wake up on a beach after a wild overnight party, only to discover that something terrifying is hiding beneath the sand. When one of their friends steps onto the beach and is suddenly attacked by a mysterious creature, the survivors realize that touching the sand could mean certain death. Trapped on objects scattered across the beach, including a lifeguard tower and a car, the group desperately searches for a way to escape without becoming the creature’s next victims. As the scorching sun, dehydration, and growing panic push them to their limits, friendships are tested and survival becomes increasingly difficult. Starring Brooke Butler, Cleo Berry, and Cynthia Murell, the film delivers creature horror, suspense, and terrifying moments while exploring fear, desperation, and the struggle to survive an unseen threat.

🎭 Genre: Horror • Sci-Fi • Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 3.8/10

🍅 Rotten Tomatoes: 18%

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 24m • Not Rated

🎥 Director: Isaac Gabaeff

✍️ Writers: Alex Greenfield & Ben Powell
